description:
Convert protein structures into a protein genbank file

Reads structure files (pdb/cif, optionally gzipped, given as files, globs, or a directory
searched recursively) or a prebuilt foldseek database, and writes one protein genbank
record per structure chain. This makes structures ordinary domainator inputs, so the
sequence-based tools (domainate.py, domain_search.py, seq_dist.py, build_ssn.py, the
reports) work on them with no further conversion.

Chain splitting, structure parsing and naming are all done by the structural aligner, so
records are named exactly as they are in a search against the same structures.

Use --keep_db to also persist the aligner database that was built along the way. That
database carries C-alpha coordinates, so it can be reused as the -i or -r argument of
structure_domainate.py / structure_search.py without paying to rebuild it, and it is how
you turn a directory of reference structures into a reusable reference database.

Note that record coordinates are indices into the *observed* residue sequence extracted
from the structure, not original PDB residue numbers: a chain with a disordered loop has a
sequence shorter than its residue-number span.

parameters.name: Input
parameters.help: structure files (pdb/cif, optionally gzipped), a directory to search recursively, a glob, or the prefix of a prebuilt foldseek database.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.help: output genbank filename. If not supplied, or if given as '-', writes to stdout. Optional when --keep_db is given.

parameters.name: Keep Db
parameters.help: also write the aligner database built from the input structures, using this path as its prefix. The database keeps C-alpha coordinates, so it can be reused as an input or reference for structure_domainate.py and structure_search.py.

parameters.name: Store 3Di
parameters.help: store each chain's 3Di structural alphabet string in a /threedi qualifier on a full-length misc_feature. Note that this qualifier is a single opaque string, so it does not survive tools that slice records (extract_domains.py, select_by_coord.py).

parameters.name: Cpu
parameters.help: number of threads to give the backend. 0 lets the backend use all available cores.

advanced_parameters.name: Foldseek Path
advanced_parameters.help: path to the foldseek executable. If not supplied, foldseek is looked up on PATH.

advanced_parameters.name: Aligner Arg
advanced_parameters.help: extra arguments appended verbatim to the backend's search command line, for options domainator does not wrap. Example: --aligner_arg --prefilter-mode 2

advanced_parameters.name: Tmp Dir
advanced_parameters.help: parent directory for temporary databases and alignment files. Structural searches can need a lot of scratch space, so point this at a large filesystem for big inputs.
